description: Align the 343-aa LIH1 form to its S. kudriavzevii and K. marxianus orthologues and plot the recovered signal peptide
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
KD={"A":1.8,"R":-4.5,"N":-3.5,"D":-3.5,"C":2.5,"Q":-3.5,"E":-3.5,"G":-0.4,"H":-3.2,"I":4.5,
    "L":3.8,"K":-3.9,"M":1.9,"F":2.8,"P":-1.6,"S":-0.8,"T":-0.7,"W":-0.9,"Y":-1.3,"V":4.2,"X":0.}
def kd(s): return np.array([KD.get(c,0.) for c in s])
def smooth(v,w=11):
    if len(v)<w: return v
    return np.convolve(v,np.ones(w)/w,"same")
bases="TCAG"; aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={}; k=0
for a in bases:
    for b in bases:
        for c in bases: CODON[a+b+c]=aas[k]; k+=1
def tr(s): return "".join(CODON.get(s[i:i+3],"X") for i in range(0,len(s)-2,3))

r=requests.get("https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/S000003868/sequence_details",timeout=150).json()
S=[d for d in r["genomic_dna"] if (d.get("strain") or {}).get("display_name")=="S288C"][0]["residues"].upper()
big=[d for d in r["1kb"] if (d.get("strain") or {}).get("display_name")=="S288C"][0]["residues"].upper()
up=big[:big.find(S)]
short=tr(S).rstrip("*"); long=tr(up[-45:])+short

def useq(a):
    j=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=90).json()
    return j["sequence"]["value"]
SK=useq("J4U0J4")      # S. kudriavzevii orthologue, 343 aa
KM=useq("A0ABX6F1A9")  # K. marxianus orthologue, 389 aa

# Smith-Waterman, identity scoring, affine gaps
def sw(a,b,m=2,mm=-1,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,p=len(a),len(b)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,p+1)); E=np.full((n+1,p+1),-1e9); F=np.full((n+1,p+1),-1e9)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,p+1),dtype=np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,p+1):
            E[i,j]=max(E[i,j-1]+ge,H[i,j-1]+go+ge)
            F[i,j]=max(F[i-1,j]+ge,H[i-1,j]+go+ge)
            d=H[i-1,j-1]+(m if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else mm)
            best=max(0,d,E[i,j],F[i,j]); H[i,j]=best
            P[i,j]=0 if best==0 else (1 if best==d else (2 if best==E[i,j] else 3))
    i,j=np.unravel_index(int(np.argmax(H)),H.shape); A=[];Bb=[]
    while P[i,j]!=0:
        if P[i,j]==1: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append(b[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif P[i,j]==2: A.append("-");Bb.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
        else: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append("-");i-=1
    A="".join(reversed(A));Bb="".join(reversed(Bb))
    ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(A,Bb) if x==y)
    return i+1,j+1,A,Bb,ident,len(A)

for lab,q,t in [("LIH1-long(343) vs S.kudriavzevii J4U0J4",long,SK),
                ("LIH1-long(343) vs K.marxianus A0ABX6F1A9",long,KM)]:
    s1,s2,A,Bb,idn,L=sw(q,t)
    print(f"{lab}:  {100*idn/L:.1f}% identity over {L} aligned positions; query starts at {s1}, subject at {s2}")
    print(f"   query N-term aligned block : {A[:45]}")
    print(f"   subject N-term aligned block: {Bb[:45]}\n")

# ---------------- Figure ----------------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,7.2),height_ratios=[1.15,1])
x=np.arange(1,61)
ax[0].plot(x,smooth(kd(long[:60])),lw=2.2,color="#b2182b",label="343 aa form (first upstream ATG)")
ax[0].plot(np.arange(16,76),smooth(kd(short[:60])),lw=2.2,color="#2166ac",ls="--",
           label="328 aa form (UniProt P47145, internal ATG)")
ax[0].axhline(1.818,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1.3)
ax[0].text(47,1.90,"signal-peptide cutoff 1.818 (ROC-AUC 0.969)",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax[0].axvspan(6,16,color="#b2182b",alpha=.13)
ax[0].axvline(21.5,color="#b2182b",lw=1.6)
ax[0].text(6.3,3.25,"Phobius n-region 6-16",fontsize=8.5,color="#b2182b")
ax[0].text(22.5,3.25,"cleavage c21/22",fontsize=8.5,color="#b2182b")
ax[0].set_xlim(1,60); ax[0].set_ylim(-3.2,3.7)
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue (numbering of the 343 aa form)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle\n(11-residue mean)")
ax[0].set_title("The LIH1 signal peptide is present in the genome and absent from the annotated protein",fontsize=11.5)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8.5,loc="lower right"); ax[0].grid(alpha=.25)

rows=[]
for d in r["genomic_dna"]:
    nm=(d.get("strain") or {}).get("display_name"); s=(d.get("residues") or "").upper()
    if not nm or len(s)<700: continue
    p=tr(s).split("*")[0]
    rows.append(["343 aa, SP+" if len(p)>335 else "328 aa, SP-"])
T=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["form"]); vc=T.form.value_counts()
ax[1].barh(["343 aa, SP+\n(codon 16 = ACG/CCT,\nno internal ATG)","328 aa, SP-\n(codon 16 = ATG)"],
           [vc.get("343 aa, SP+",0),vc.get("328 aa, SP-",0)],
           color=["#b2182b","#2166ac"],height=.5)
for i,v in enumerate([vc.get("343 aa, SP+",0),vc.get("328 aa, SP-",0)]):
    ax[1].text(v+.4,i,f"{v}/42 strains",va="center",fontsize=9.5)
ax[1].set_xlim(0,30); ax[1].set_xlabel("S. cerevisiae strains with this SGD gene model")
ax[1].set_title("Half of S. cerevisiae isolates lack the internal ATG entirely, so they can only make the SP+ form",fontsize=10.5)
ax[1].grid(axis="x",alpha=.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
